def execute_phoenix_supernova_dota(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Transforms into a burning sun-like object that enemies must destroy or be stunned by its rebirth.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    assert can_enter_form(actor,requested_form)
    transition_actor_state(actor,TRANSFORMING)
    swap_mesh_skeleton_collision_and_move_set(actor,requested_form)
    apply_only_configured_form_stat_modifiers(actor)
    on_form_end: revert_all_owned_form_changes()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
